100% vector illustration English preview

This preview shows an inline SVG. Download an interactive HTML demo to switch between languages after export. An SVG displayed as an ordinary image does not automatically change languages; a publishing system needs integration for that.

Why this exists

Less production overhead.
More accessible communication.

People should be able to focus on their message instead of solving typography, layout, translation, and image-format problems from scratch.

Prototype limits: This tool uses example styles—not official government branding. It keeps text as text and uses an opaque panel for predictable contrast. It does not certify WCAG conformance or the quality of translations. Review exported graphics and supply a context-appropriate HTML alt attribute when publishing them as images.

The interactive demo is a standalone HTML page, not a multilingual SVG file or Drupal integration. Open the downloaded HTML in a browser and use its language buttons.

Built independently as an open-ended experiment. Source in the portfolio repository ↗
